provenance.inputs_summary: amcrax.economics.singapore.evaluate (default capex_mode reference) on results/simulations/baseline.json and baseline_no_hi.json; ranges from the reference scenario (REF.sens), data/singapore.yaml NH3 ranges, and results/research/singapore/tornado.json bounds

label: Uncertainty of a model given its stated input ranges. Not experimental validation.
method: Saltelli et al. (2010) first order, Jansen (1999) total effect; scrambled Sobol base sample (scipy.stats.qmc, seed 20261123), N = 8192, bootstrap 95 % CI with 1000 row resamples; grouped indices swap all columns of a group
notes: Carbon tax omitted from the inputs: ammonia-fired heat has no direct CO2 so evaluate ignores it (index exactly 0); tested as a dummy input (checks T1-DUMMY-*). No natural-gas heat case exists in the reference scenario.
plant_life_yr enters NPV through int(round(...)) only: its NPV index reflects a step function.
Heat integration and capacity are design choices, reported as separate cases (capacity scale 1).
NH3 price drives both the feed and the ammonia-fuelled heat; it is one input, so the feed group includes heat-fuel cost.
NH3 low/high from data/singapore.yaml nh3_price_scenarios_USD_per_t (the reference scenario holds the base values only); same as monte_carlo.json.
